name: orqevio-copy
description: Your own copy of Orqevio on Cloudflare.

SETUP_CODE.description: One-off code to claim your copy the first time: at least 12 letters or digits, for example from `openssl rand -hex 8`. Keep it until you open your copy; to recover access later, set a new one here and use **Lost your key?** on the sign-in screen.

UPLOADS.description: R2 bucket for the files attached to cards and documents.

COPY.description: Durable Object that keeps your data in its own SQLite database.
